experiment: DEPTH S1W: charged S1JOINT L1→L warm-start vs cold S1JOINT and QAOA p=L
n18_forbidden_unless_both_gates: Adopt further N18 only if Gate A and Gate B both pass at N15 L2

hypothesis.one_sentence: Nov3's L1 energy edge is wasted by cold L≥2 S1JOINT; charging 1024 queries to L1 then embedding into L (Uc+shell0 copied, extra shells 0, full-vector C0 continue) beats cold S1JOINT and equal-layer QAOA at the same Q=1024·L.
hypothesis.not: Not DEPTH C1 (that used 4 starts). No extra Q. No ALT. Not a GR patch. No BFGS/natgrad.

frozen.Q_rule: Q=1024*L inclusive, matching S1SH/S1ALT23/DEPTH C1 fair prior, not a fixed Q=2048
frozen.COLD: exact S1JOINT: nstarts=1 TQA at that L, joint IID C0, split_cap(Q,1), ncal=4, A=25, live gain, last+Polyak, engine m2. This is the fair recipe that already lost energy to QAOA at L≥2.
frozen.QAOA: exact S1JOINT p=L, same Q, same starts/gain/readout. Cold control, not a QAOA warm-start.

WARM.L1: S1JOINT at L=1, cap Q1=1024 (one layer-equivalent), K=507, TQA L=1 start, charged
WARM.embed: x_L = [γ,θK,θM,(s1,s2,s3)_0 from L1*] concatenated with extra shells exact 0. Shared Uc is NOT frozen: continue is full-vector C0 (lightly refined).
WARM.continue: one start = pad(x_L1*). cap Q-1024. L=2 rem 1024 K=507; L=3 rem 2048 K=1019. Live gain, last+Polyak. Distinct RNG mid=240.
WARM.no_free_prefix: L1 candidates and continue calibration are inside Q. Padded point is not a free L-candidate.

seeds.collision_check: no instance/run filenames; skip local R15 10120-10127; prior LE ≤10111; DEPTH C1 10036-43; STARTS ≤10111; FT 10018-25; N3COND 10010-17; validation 11000-11031; final 20000-20999

allocation.inclusive: All L1 + continue queries inside Q. Failures inside Q. No free L1.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy at the evaluation depth. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.A: WARM mean energy < COLD: bootstrap 95% CI of mean(E_WARM - E_COLD) entirely below 0
gate.B: WARM mean energy < QAOA: bootstrap 95% CI of mean(E_WARM - E_QAOA) entirely below 0
gate.adopt_n18: only if BOTH A and B pass at N15 L2
gate.otherwise: STOP. Do not retune split. Do not patch GR. Do not run N18.
gate.report: All N×L cells. Fidelity post hoc.
